reading.title: Animal Communication and Social Behavior
reading.passage: Animal communication systems have evolved to facilitate the transmission of information within and between species, playing a critical role in survival and reproduction. Primates, in particular, exhibit sophisticated vocal and gestural communication networks that extend far beyond simple alarm calls. Research by primatologists has demonstrated that chimpanzees employ context-dependent vocalizations, adjusting their calls based on the presence of dominant individuals and environmental threats. Furthermore, recent studies employing neuroimaging techniques have revealed that the brains of social species show enhanced development in regions associated with processing social information. This neural plasticity suggests that complex social environments exert selective pressure, favoring individuals with superior communication abilities. The implications of these findings extend beyond academic interest; understanding animal communication systems provides invaluable insights into the evolutionary origins of human language and cognition.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one key function of animal communication systems?
options: A) To establish territorial boundaries exclusively
B) To facilitate the transmission of information for survival and reproduction
C) To prevent inter-species interaction
D) To replace gestural communication entirely
questions.explanation: 첫 문장에서 동물 커뮤니케이션 시스템이 '생존과 번식을 위한 정보 전달'을 촉진한다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from the passage about chimpanzee communication?
options: A) Chimpanzees only use alarm calls to communicate
B) Chimpanzees adjust their vocalizations based on social context
C) Chimpanzees cannot process social information
D) Chimpanzees lack the ability to use gestural communication
questions.explanation: 두 번째 문장에서 침팬지가 '맥락에 따라 달라지는 발성을 사용하고, 지배적 개체와 환경 위협의 존재에 따라 울음소리를 조정한다'고 설명합니다.

questions.q: The word 'plasticity' in the passage is closest in meaning to
options: A) Rigidity and inflexibility
B) The ability to adapt and change
C) Permanent structural damage
D) Resistance to environmental influence
questions.explanation: 'Plasticity'는 복잡한 사회 환경에서 뇌가 변화한다는 맥락에서 '적응 능력과 변화 가능성'을 의미합니다.

questions.q: Why does the author mention neuroimaging techniques?
options: A) To criticize primate research methods
B) To provide evidence that social species have enhanced brain development in communication-related regions
C) To suggest that animals cannot communicate effectively
D) To explain why human language is superior to animal communication
questions.explanation: 신경 영상화 기술은 사회적 종의 뇌 발달을 입증하는 과학적 증거를 제시하기 위해 언급되었습니다.

sentences.original: Animal communication systems have evolved to facilitate the transmission of information within and between species, playing a critical role in survival and reproduction.
sentences.paraphrase: The evolution of animal communication has enabled species to exchange vital information necessary for their survival and reproductive success.
sentences.tip: 능동→수동 표현을 동사 구조로 변환하고, 복합 구조를 단순화하여 의미 유지

sentences.original: Primates, in particular, exhibit sophisticated vocal and gestural communication networks that extend far beyond simple alarm calls.
sentences.paraphrase: Among animals, primates stand out for their highly developed systems of vocal and gestural communication, which go well beyond basic warning signals.
sentences.tip: 복잡한 관계절 구조를 전치사구로 단순화하고 'extend far beyond'를 'go well beyond'로 동의어 치환

sentences.original: Research by primatologists has demonstrated that chimpanzees employ context-dependent vocalizations, adjusting their calls based on the presence of dominant individuals and environmental threats.
sentences.paraphrase: Primatologists have shown through their research that chimpanzees modify their vocal expressions in response to social hierarchy and environmental dangers.
sentences.tip: 구체적 표현('context-dependent vocalizations')을 더 간단한 동사구('modify their vocal expressions')로 대체

sentences.original: This neural plasticity suggests that complex social environments exert selective pressure, favoring individuals with superior communication abilities.
sentences.paraphrase: The capacity of the brain to adapt indicates that animals living in complex social groups experience evolutionary advantages if they possess strong communication skills.
sentences.tip: 학술 용어('neural plasticity', 'selective pressure')를 설명적 표현으로 풀어서 표현

sentences.original: Understanding animal communication systems provides invaluable insights into the evolutionary origins of human language and cognition.
sentences.paraphrase: By studying how animals communicate, researchers can better understand how human language and thought processes first emerged through evolution.
sentences.tip: 추상적 명사구('invaluable insights into')를 구체적 동사구('better understand how')로 변환

writing_prompt.prompt: Many countries are experiencing declining birth rates and aging populations. Governments are implementing various policies such as childcare subsidies, parental leave, tax incentives, and housing support to encourage people to have more children. Discuss what you think are the most effective policies to address low birth rates. Use specific examples and reasons to support your answer.
writing_prompt.instruction: 최소 300단어 이상의 학술적 에세이 작성. 서론에서 입장 제시, 본론에서 2-3개의 근거 제시 및 구체적 사례 포함, 결론에서 재강조

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer shopping online for convenience and variety. Others prefer shopping in physical stores to see products in person and get immediate assistance. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details.
model_sentences: Personally, I prefer shopping online because it offers greater convenience and a wider selection of products.
First, online shopping saves me time since I can browse and purchase from home without traveling to multiple stores.
For example, when I need to buy electronics or clothing, I can easily compare prices and read customer reviews across different websites within minutes.
Additionally, online retailers often provide better deals and discounts than physical stores, which helps me save money.
Although some people enjoy the experience of trying products before buying, I find the ease and efficiency of online shopping far more practical for my lifestyle.

listening.title: 기숙사 배정 및 룸메이트 배치 문의
listening.script: Student A: Hi, I have a question about dormitory assignment for next semester. I submitted my housing application three weeks ago, but I haven't received any confirmation yet. Student B: Oh, I understand your concern. The housing office processes applications in batches, so it usually takes four to six weeks for a decision. Student A: Four to six weeks? That's longer than I expected. Is there any way to expedite the process? Student B: Well, you could visit the housing office in person during their office hours, which are Monday through Friday from 10 AM to 2 PM. Bring your application receipt and student ID. They might be able to give you an update. Student A: That sounds helpful. Also, I wanted to request a specific roommate. Is it too late to submit a roommate preference form? Student B: Not at all. You can submit a roommate request form even after initial assignment, but it has to be done within two weeks of receiving your housing assignment letter. Student A: Great! One more thing—I'm an international student, and I prefer to be housed with someone who can help me adjust to campus life. Do you think the office can accommodate that? Student B: Definitely. The housing office takes special circumstances into consideration. Just mention this in the additional comments section of your form. They'll do their best to match you with a compatible roommate.

questions.q: What is the main reason Student A visits the housing office?
options: A) To submit a housing application
B) To inquire about the status of their dormitory assignment
C) To change their dormitory location
D) To request a single room instead of sharing
questions.explanation: Student A는 3주 전에 기숙사 신청을 했는데 아직 확인 메시지를 받지 못해 상태를 문의하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What does Student B suggest to expedite the housing decision?
options: A) Submit another application immediately
B) Contact the housing office by phone
C) Visit the housing office in person with application receipt and student ID
D) Wait for two more weeks
questions.explanation: Student B는 월요일부터 금요일 오전 10시부터 오후 2시 사이에 기숙사 사무소를 직접 방문하고 신청 영수증과 학생증을 가져가라고 제안합니다.

questions.q: Why does Student A want to be housed with someone who can help them adjust to campus life?
options: A) Because they are an international student
B) Because they are a first-year student
C) Because they have difficulty making friends
D) Because they struggle with English
questions.explanation: Student A는 국제 학생이기 때문에 캠퍼스 생활에 적응하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있는 사람과 함께 있고 싶다고 명시합니다.
